COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Intercultural competence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Intercultural competence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Intercultural competence.
   C. Say Intercultural competence never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Intercultural competence as rumours only.

2. Which statement about Self- Awareness in the Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Self- Awareness in the Community never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Self- Awareness in the Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Self- Awareness in the Community as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Awareness in the Community.

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Name the president

4. Which statement about Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp.
   C. Say Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Community Needs is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Community Needs never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Community Needs as rumours only.
   C. Explain Community Needs with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Community Needs.

6. Which statement about Responsible Decision Making is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Responsible Decision Making with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Responsible Decision Making as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Responsible Decision Making.
   D. Say Responsible Decision Making never happens in Kenya.

7. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Avoiding all community work

8. Which statement about Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr.
   B. Say Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr as rumours only.

9. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Ignore prices in shops

10. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Kisumu

11. Which statement about Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision.
   C. Treat Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision as rumours only.
   D. Say Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Leadership Development is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Leadership Development with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Leadership Development never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Leadership Development.
   D. Treat Leadership Development as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

====

1. A — Explain Intercultural competence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. B — Explain Self- Awareness in the Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. C — Explain symbols used on a map

4. D — Explain Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. C — Explain Community Needs with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. A — Explain Responsible Decision Making with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. B — Obeying laws and caring for public property

8. C — Explain Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. A — Plan income and spending wisely

10. C — Nairobi

11. A — Explain Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. A — Explain Leadership Development with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

16. (4 marks)
